name: Native feature bottleneck audit followed by ordinary decoder adaptation
status: Staged exploratory plan. Official native feature/caching stage implemented; ordinary loss/parameter-selection helper tested. Full adaptation runner and any regional mechanism are conditional work, not completed experiments.
native_gate: Complete unobserved and observed native trajectories on seq2/seq13; prediction hashes, full metrics and current stored-output fingerprints must match bit-for-bit. Fresh author model per sequence/pass. Source weights unchanged. Save/load native-bank and stage-tensor values/layout verified. No MedSAM2 bank may enter this model.
cohort: Only after the gate: all21 promptable sequences /2012 postprompt targets. Reuse matching observed gate trajectories/banks without re-inference. Keep native frame schedule, all spatial and pointer tokens, original prompt and own predicted writes.
feature_audit: On fixed66 cases, save unconditioned current low-resolution image features, final memory-conditioned features, high-resolution decoder inputs, raw mask candidates, IoU predictions, object score, selected native mask and original GT. Assert decoder low-resolution input equals final memory-conditioned feature reshaping. Capture allfour native attention layer/key counts. No feature purity claim or alteration.
failure_analysis: Report native mask outcome, existing BoundaryF, precision/recall, GT-empty false alarms and native object score. Do not label all overlapping errors as contour-only errors. Mask arrays allow independent pixel rescoring and inspection. Fixed cases are exploratory outcome-stratified medians selected under the prior medical checkpoint, not representative or prospectively selected official-checkpoint failures.

ordinary_baseline.scope: Train native sam_mask_decoder core only, no regional branch. Freeze image_encoder, memory_attention, memory_encoder, pointer projection, and sam_mask_decoder.conv_s0/conv_s1. This is decoder-core adaptation, not full-decoder or full-author-recipe reproduction.
ordinary_baseline.loss: Pinned author MultiStepMultiMasksAndIous unchanged: focal20, Dice1, IoU1, presence1; supervise_all_iou=True, iou_use_l1_loss=True. Inputs are raw pre-suppression decoder masks resized to1024; target resized nearest to1024. This raw-mask feed is a disclosed project adaptation.
ordinary_baseline.history: Author-sampled clips with original strictly past native teacher prefix; within-clip own differentiable predictions/writes. Original full-video timing. No later GT prompts. This remains truncated teacher-prefix training, not full-video on-policy training.
ordinary_baseline.guard: Cached image features allowed only while encoder and both decoder high-resolution projectors are frozen; reject otherwise. Separate real-data no-update identity/gradient/finite-update/predicted-write gate before any CV.
ordinary_baseline.selection: Final epoch only, no validation-based checkpoint or hyperparameter selection. Fresh weights per fold.
ordinary_baseline.evaluation: Whole original videos, same native initial prompt only, own predictions/memory, no oracle boxes or teacher banks. Primary equal-sequence present Dice; IoU, BoundaryF, GT-empty false alarms, overlap re-detection and runtime alongside. Sequence-level bootstrap/Wilcoxon; no patient-independence claim.
ordinary_baseline.screen: Meaningful baseline gain requires mean Dice>=+0.01, at least14/21 sequence wins, positive95%CI lower bound, paired p<0.05, and no extra pooled GT-empty false alarms. Do not alter rules after results.
ordinary_baseline.launch_status: Not launched; real-data training gate and complete runner still required.
ordinary_baseline.runtime_mode: Native modules remain in eval mode, with autograd enabled for decoder-core parameters. Reject a training-mode image encoder or trainable high-resolution projection when using cached features. This preserves native dropout/selection behavior and is a disclosed adaptation, not full author training reproduction.

regional_stage: Design and freeze one mechanism only after official-checkpoint diagnosis and ordinary-baseline evidence. Compare against the equally trained ordinary adaptation and a parameter/compute-matched nonregional addition, plus frozen native. No confidence gates, new inference thresholds or frame-quality selection. No architecture or claimed gain is prespecified here.
external_confirmation: Deferred until an untouched dataset is available. PolypGen remains exploratory after repeated design; seq16-23 cannot be relabelled untouched. Published compatible baselines may be reused but cannot replace matched local Dice/reference statistics.
stopping: Stop on implementation/integrity failure. Never modify the running experiment because accuracy is unexpected. Do not launch another regional variant to chase an improvement without the preceding evidence.
